name: Barkour
description:
About This Game

GOOD BOY. TOP AGENT.

Meet Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. - a highly trained special agent, master of parkour, high-tech gadgets and getting into trouble.

He may be one of M.A.N.'s finest agents, but underneath all that spy gear, he's still a (not so) ordinary dog. He wags his tail, follows his nose and sometimes lets his canine instincts get the better of perfectly professional Agent behaviour.

Fortunately, saving the world sometimes calls for exactly that.

YOUR MISSION. YOUR METHODS.

Run across walls, grind along rails and leap through missions with canine agility. Sneak through the shadows, distract enemies with spy gadgets, find a secret passage... or forget subtlety altogether and jump straight into the action.

BARKOUR blends fast-paced platforming, stealth, combat and high-tech gadgets, giving you the freedom to tackle each challenge your way.

Experiment with an arsenal of over 30 gadgets, discover alternate routes and turn every mission into T.H.U.N.D.E.R.'s personal playground.

AND REMEMBER - STEALTH IS OPTIONAL. MAKING A MESS DEFINITELY ISN'T.

A WORLD WORTH SNIFFING AROUND.

Gothic castles, overgrown greenhouses, creepy amusement parks, secret facilities and places no dog was ever supposed to enter. T.H.U.N.D.E.R.'s missions will take you through wildly different worlds.

Step off the obvious path. Sniff out hidden passages, secret rooms, collectibles, challenges and surprises tucked throughout handcrafted missions.

And take your time. Sometimes the best part of saving the world is finding out what the developers hid behind that suspicious-looking wall.

A SPY ADVENTURE WITH A VERY GOOD BOY AT ITS HEART.

BARKOUR is built on humor, absurdity and carefully controlled canine chaos. But T.H.U.N.D.E.R.'s adventure has another side to it, too.

Meet 26 distinctive characters in a story packed with allies, villains, unexpected twists and situations you definitely will not find in any special agent handbook. Visual comedy, expressive characters and gags are mixed with more emotional moments.

Give T.H.U.N.D.E.R. your own style with over 100 customization items, including ideas inspired by our community.

And because even the best Agent is still a dog, there are over 30 emotes inspired by real canine behaviour. The kind that makes dog owners say: “Oh my God, my dog does exactly that!”

OVER 15 HOURS OF GAMEPLAY. COUNTLESS QUESTIONABLE DECISIONS.

ONE VERY GOOD BOY.
short_desc: BARKOUR is a fast-paced action platformer with a stealthy twist, starring Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. - a tail-wagging master of parkour, high-tech gadgets and getting into trouble. Jump, sneak and fight your way through a spy adventure packed with action, canine chaos and delightfully absurd surprises.
